messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a tiny-traffic safe-flip for the canary pool tonight at 20:30 PT. Goal: validate fastpath batching under load with ~1% of traffic. Need an owner to flip, run smoke checks, and be ready to roll back within 15m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tiny-traffic-safeflip :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: I can take ownership if tj + sophia are OK with me triggering. I'll be on-call and available 20:15–21:00.

tj: +1 to maya. Quick Q: does this flip also change the `max_batch_size` config? I thought that was blocked until tomorrow.

alex: No — this is flag-only. `max_batch_size` is not part of tonight's flip. Smoke checklist (short): 1) trace sampling confirms new fastpath, 2) p95 latency not regressing >50ms, 3) error rate <= baseline +0.1%, 4) KV-cache hit rates unchanged. Full steps are in the runbook.

sophia: I'll run the smoke-suite and watch traces/logs. Can we get a temporary dashboard with the essential panels? ops-bot can spin one up if needed.

ops-bot: Dashboard created: https://grafana.redwood/d/tny/safeflip-canary?orgId=1 — panels: p95_latency, error_rate, kv_cache_hit, trace_rate. Alerts: latency_pct95_warn, error_rate_warn are wired to #oncall.

maya: Plan: flip at 20:30 PT -> verify green for 10 minutes -> if stable, ramp to 5% at 21:00 (manual). If any check fails, rollback immediately. Rollback: flip percentage back to 0 and notify this thread + call pager if thresholds exceeded.

tj: I'll watch tenant-routing and per-tenant batching histograms. If I see error spike I'll request rollback.

alex: Flip command for our internal flag service (example):
```
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/tiny_traffic/activate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"percentage":1, "safe_default":true}'
```
Note: `safe_default:true` ensures unknown models use the old path.

maya: Copy. I'll paste the exact command I run here when we go live. I'll also post a short smoke checklist result (p95, error-rate, traces).

sophia: Quick ask — who will cover EU post-flip verification? I can stay on for +30m to watch EU panels and spot any region-specific regressions.

alex: Thanks — @maya you're owner. @sophia will cover EU. Please tag `#flip` when you flip and paste the curl you used. I'll be available for escalation. :thumbsup:
